claims.text: The museum’s rail-segment date and the transport council’s dated oil shipment describe different pieces of a network. Together they support an attributed oil-transport connection, not a single direct train journey or pipeline. Both selected acts lie within the original period; no 1907 pipeline event is imported. Institutional retrospectives do not settle territorial legitimacy, and original timetables and manifests remain uncollated.
